title: dendranthema erubescens
intro: Dendranthema erubescens, commonly known as Korean fire chrysanthemum or Chinese chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant in the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine. The health benefits of Dendranthema erubescens include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and improve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
